spans.s:
युक्त॑ग्रावन् a. having set in motion (lit. harnessed)
the Soma-stones.
युक्तचेष्ट a. acting or behaving properly.

युक्ति f. junction, connection (also of words, i.e.)
sentence, preparation, application, use, employment, practice, means,
expedient, trick, contrivance, stratagem, cause, motive, argument,
correctness, fitness, propriety. —युक्तिं कृ find a means or try an
art. युक्त्या & युक्तितस properly, fitly, duly;
 by means or by virtue
of (—˚).
